name: Magnum Almond
ingredients_raw: ICE CREAM: WATER, MILK SOLIDS, SUGAR, LIQUID GLUCOSE, EMULSIFIER - E471, STABILISERS - E410, E412 AND E407, NATURAL COLOUR (BETA CAROTENE) AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE, OUTER LAYER: MILK COMPOUND COATING (24.85%): SUGAR, COCOA BUTTER, MILK SOLIDS, COCOA SOLIDS, COCONUT OIL, EMULSIFIER - E322, VANILLIN; MILK COVERING CHOCOLATE* (8.28%): SUGAR, COCOA BUTTER, MILK SOLIDS, COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER - E322, VANILLIN; NUTS, ALMONDS (4.73%). *MILK COVERING CHOCOLATE IS BELGIAN CHOCOLATE. Contains Soy, Milk and Almonds. May contain Wheat, Barley, Peanuts and other tree nuts.
